subject: Various AArch64 speed hacks

units.name: Various AArch64 speed hacks
units.evidence: AArch64 raw accumulate has an Alive2 counterexample, but a reoptimized scalar variant proves and ARMv7 controls prove; x86 fixed API targets prove except a non-returning long target. No validated public AArch64 hash counterexample.

notes: AArch64 intrinsic/model and optimizer representation differences prevent promotion of the raw witness.
